# ImagesCollide

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Images](BlitzBasic-Images)

</div>


```blitzbasic
ImagesCollide:Int32 image1:Int32, x1:Int32, y1:Int32, frame1:Int32, image2:Int32, x2:Int32, y2:Int32, frame2:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `image1` | In | Int32 | required | The first image. |
| `x1` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position where the first image is drawn. |
| `y1` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position where the first image is drawn. |
| `frame1` | In | Int32 | required | The frame of the first image. |
| `image2` | In | Int32 | required | The second image. |
| `x2` | In | Int32 | required | Horizontal position where the second image is drawn. |
| `y2` | In | Int32 | required | Vertical position where the second image is drawn. |
| `frame2` | In | Int32 | required | The frame of the second image. |

**Returns:** 1 if visible pixels of the two images are on top of each other, otherwise 0.

## Description

Tells whether two images touch, looking at the pixels that are visible. Both images are taken at their handle, and the frame to test is given for each.

## Differences

* A frame number that does not exist stops the program with an error message.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local a = CreateImage(80, 80)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(a)
Color 255, 160, 0
Oval 0, 0, 80, 80, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Local b = CopyImage(a)
Cls
DrawImage a, 60, 40
DrawImage b, 125, 105
Color 255, 255, 255
Text 10, 190, "ImagesOverlap: " + ImagesOverlap(a, 60, 40, b, 125, 105)
Text 10, 206, "ImagesCollide: " + ImagesCollide(a, 60, 40, 0, b, 125, 105, 0)
Flip
WaitKey
```
